|lore=Native of Chandrila. Leader of the Alliance. A former member of the Imperial Senate where she was a formidable opponent to then-Senator Palpatine. Friend of Bail Organa.
|game_text='''Agendas''': order, peace. Emperor may not target characters with politics here. Once per turn, if in a senate majority, may take your just drawn battle destiny into hand. Once per game, may deploy a battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

|notes=The recovered original Players Committee sheet is linked from the [[Mon Mothma (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original 2005)|2005 publication]]. The remaster removes the game-text protection and the Epic Event destiny action, adds a senate-majority battle destiny action, and changes deploy, forfeit and politics. Its agendas, Emperor prohibition and battleground action remain.
